##### Project general facts

Ice Beach by Major Developments at Marjan Beach is a stunning waterfront development that perfectly blends modern architecture with a resort-inspired lifestyle. The project offers a diverse selection of residences, including one-bedroom apartments in Mini, Standard, and Luxury layouts, two-bedroom homes available in Standard and spacious Duplex configurations, elegant three-bedroom apartments, and exclusive Sky Villas for those seeking ultimate privacy and prestige. Each home is carefully designed to provide breathtaking views, abundant natural light, and a refined yet comfortable living experience.

Residents will enjoy access to premium amenities that transform everyday living into a five-star retreat. The private beach club creates an exclusive seaside atmosphere, offering a peaceful escape just steps from home. Spectacular swimming pools, leisure decks, wellness facilities, and entertainment areas are all thoughtfully integrated to deliver relaxation, fun, and sophistication in one vibrant destination.

All residences will be delivered fully furnished, allowing homeowners to move in effortlessly and immediately enjoy their new space. The kitchens come fully equipped with high-quality appliances, combining modern design with everyday practicality. Premium materials, elegant finishes, and carefully selected details throughout each unit create a stylish, contemporary ambiance that reflects true luxury living.

##### Location description and benefits

Marjan Beach is one of the most desirable coastal destinations in the emirate, offering residents a serene waterfront lifestyle framed by the calm waters of the Arabian Gulf. Located within the iconic Al Marjan Island, the beach combines natural beauty with carefully planned infrastructure and a refined resort atmosphere. Soft white sands, crystal-clear waters, and beautifully maintained promenades create a setting that feels both exclusive and welcoming. It is a place where everyday life unfolds against a backdrop of open sea views and refreshing coastal breezes.

For residents, Marjan Beach offers a harmonious balance between relaxation and activity. Morning walks along the shoreline, sunset yoga sessions, and water sports become part of a healthy, inspiring routine. The area is surrounded by upscale resorts, charming cafés, and leisure attractions, all within easy reach yet thoughtfully integrated to preserve tranquility. The environment is clean, secure, and designed to provide comfort throughout the year.

Living by Marjan Beach means enjoying a resort-style lifestyle without leaving home. The community atmosphere is peaceful and family-friendly, making it ideal for both full-time residents and holiday homeowners. Expansive sea views and open horizons create a sense of space and freedom that is increasingly rare. It is a destination that continues to grow in prestige, offering long-term value alongside an exceptional quality of life.
